invariant_patterns.brief: UNIQUE constraint on (sku, location); no two rows share the pair, so a repeat write updates in place rather than storing a duplicate (realizes R3, AC3).
sku, location, quantity and inventory_code are NOT NULL; a filed stock record always carries the full pair, quantity and combined code (AC1).
CHECK (quantity >= 0); a stored stock level is never negative (realizes the non-negative half of R2 at the schema level).

Initial create_table: after a single-step downgrade-then-upgrade the stock_records table with its columns and constraints is recreated (schema recreation semantics; there are no pre-existing rows to preserve on an initial migration).
